@onboardingFinish.description: Calls the original author-save helper, then endWelcomeFlow. Empty manual fields remain allowed and do not clear existing global Git values. The view must not write Git configuration.

@onboardingDeleteLock.description: Requires explicit checkbox consent. Sends an action only; the original presenter owns the lock path and deletion. Does not retry Finish automatically.

@signInExpectedLogin.description: Login is original SignInStore view data, not an editable credential.

popupReplyFailed: The action could not be completed. Review the details and try again.

@fetchUpdates.description: Runs the original Desktop fetch continuation, not pull, merge, or push retry.

@popupUnsupported.description: Unknown original popups stay blocking. Do not attach a pretend submit or close action.

@popupDontAskAgain.description: Checked means false for confirmCommitMessageOverride and askForConfirmationOnForcePush in the original reply. Cancel does not update either preference.

@popupHookFailedNotice.description: The original hook name is presentation data; only abort and ignore continuations are available.

@popupRepositoryAccountNotice.description: Repository name is presentation data. Choosing an account never changes Git author identity.

@openFile.description: Opens the focused native file review. Does not change which whole files are included in the local commit.

@saveVersion.description: A real local Git commit using upstream staging and hooks, never a push. Hide unless the service advertises repository.commit.

@fileCount.description: Number of real files in the selected working tree or changeset.

@upstreamLabel.description: The upstream and real local/remote divergence; not a fetch action.

@imageInfo.description: Image media type and size reported by the service.

@commitStats.description: Line counts from a real commit changeset.

quitWaitingForWork: {count, plural, one {Waiting for # operation to finish. Gitowl will quit when it is done.} other {Waiting for # operations to finish. Gitowl will quit when they are done.}}
saveProviderFirst: Save the connection before managing models
windowPreferenceFailed: Window setting error. Current close behavior: {behavior}.

@aheadBehind.description: A project's branch divergence from its upstream, from the original repository list.

@notPushed.description: A history record that exists only locally; the original GitStore's local commits.

@tagNotPushed.description: Tooltip of a tag the next push will publish.

@selectedOfTotal.description: How many changed files are included in the version.
